caseName: O'Donovan v. United States ex rel. De Lucia
caseNameFull: O'Donovan, U. S. Marshal v. United States ex rel. De Lucia
attorneys: Solicitor General Perlman for petitioner. Wm. Scott Stewart and George Callaghan for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit dismissed on motion of counsel for the petitioner.

Mr. Justice Clark took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
